_orderMenus_instructions: Powers the itemized Order form at /booking/ AND is read server-side by the Worker to price + validate every submitted order — so this is the one place to edit prices, and both sides always agree. price_cents is in whole cents (2400 = $24.00). per_guest:true means the price is multiplied by the guest/box count; per_guest:false means it's a flat add-on. quoted:true items have no price_cents (shown as "Custom quote", excluded from the auto-computed total — the admin sets the real total when approving). All prices below are PLACEHOLDERS carried over from the template menus you uploaded (which had blank pricing) — replace with your real prices before going live.
